subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should unpinned Copilot Responses models automatically replace managed search with hosted search without an explicit provider capability, and should this payload policy become public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The transport supports the native tool, but automatic routing changes existing behavior for forward-compatible models and the SDK export creates a durable external contract; source inspection cannot determine the intended product and API policy.

options.title: Explicit support with fallback
options.body: Use authoritative capability data or a maintained Copilot allowlist, preserve managed search otherwise, and expose shared API only with owner approval.

options.title: Keep managed search default
options.body: Retain current routing until Copilot support is reliably discoverable or users explicitly opt into native search.

options.title: Accept prefix inference
options.body: Approve automatic family-name routing and own unsupported or future model failures as an intentional compatibility tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Explicit support with fallback
recommendation.body: Use authoritative capability data or a maintained Copilot allowlist, preserve managed search otherwise, and expose shared API only with owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the dynamic arbitrary-model behavior whose compatibility contract this routing change modifies.
